meta.title: Pricing: every MepMail plan on one page
meta.description: MepMail pricing in USD: free with 100 emails/day, Pro from US$ 20 for 110,000 emails/month and Scale up to 2.75M. Overage per 1,000 and no lock-in.
meta.launchDescription: Every plan on one page: Mail from US$ 2.90 a month, and Send free with 100 emails a day or Pro with 110K emails for US$ 29 a month.

title: Mail by mailbox. <highlight>Send by volume.</highlight>
lead: Monthly prices in USD, no lock-in. Mail is priced by a plan of mailboxes on your domain; Send by your app's email volume. Use one, the other or both in the same account, with the same verified domain.
note: Send starts free: 100 emails a day, no card. Mail has 7 days free with a card on the team's first plan; billing starts when the trial ends unless you cancel before.

plans.title: Every Send plan.
plans.intro: Regular monthly fees. The Pro 110K introductory offer and annual option are detailed below. Open the usage details for queue and overage rules.

included.title: What every Send plan carries, Free included.
included.body: Included in every plan. No add-ons needed.
points: Resend-compatible HTTPS API at api.mepmail.dev. Keep the official SDK and change the base URL.
SMTP relay with STARTTLS at smtp.mepmail.dev:2587.
Your own sending domain, verified with DKIM and MAIL FROM on Amazon SES.
Dedicated API key, delivery logs, suppression list and metrics in the panel.
The official MCP server, so agents send through the same account.

alternatives.title: Coming from Resend?
alternatives.body: We put both ladders side by side, with Resend's public prices and the date they were read.

items.a: Free and Starter have a daily limit (UTC) and no overage: sends keep going up to 50% past it, then wait in a queue for the next day, and new sends are refused only when that queue reaches 3× the daily limit. Annual Pro 110K (US$ 290 a year) has a 110,000 monthly allowance with no paid overage. On monthly Pro and Scale, overage comes switched on (you can turn it off in Billing) and is billed per 1,000 at the plan’s rate, up to a safety ceiling of 5× the included volume in total (the volume plus up to 4× in overage). With overage off, or past that ceiling, new sends are refused until the period renews.

items.q: Can I use Mail and Send together?
items.a: Yes, in the same account and on the same verified domain. Mail handles mailboxes for people and agents; Send handles your app's email by API or SMTP. Each has its own credential and limit, and you pay the sum of the plans you pick, with no required bundle. With Mail active, Send Free accepts up to 3 domains (10 with Equipe).

In Send, each recipient (To, Cc and Bcc) of an accepted email counts as one email: a message to 3 people uses 3. Addresses already on your suppression list do not count. If delivery fails later, the send still counts. In Mail, the outbound limit is recipients per month, counting To, Cc and Bcc of each message sent. A send that never left does not count; a bounce after the provider accepted it does. Mail and Send limits are separate: one never uses up the other.

items.q: Is there a contract, and can I change plans later?
items.a: Pro 110K offers monthly and a prepaid 12-month annual period. Annual costs US$ 290, without stacking the introductory monthly promotion. Available subscription actions appear in the dashboard; subscriptions bought earlier keep their contracted price while they stay active.

items.q: What is the attachment limit per message?
items.a: 1 MB on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro and 10 MB on Scale. This is the sum of the decoded attachments, not each file separately.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: Not on Send Free. Mail has 7 days free with a card on the team's first plan: the first charge happens when the trial ends unless you cancel before, and a reminder arrives 2 days earlier. During the trial, sending from Mail is limited to 50 recipients a day and 200 in total. In Send, the Pro 110K offer costs US$ 29/month, with US$ 20 only on the first month for eligible new customers, or US$ 290/year upfront.

Yes, in Brazil. Send and Correio take Pix as well as card, in reais. With Pix you pay one period at a time: each renewal arrives as an invoice to pay with Pix within 5 days, never charged automatically. Correio's 7-day free trial is card only. Boleto is not accepted.

items.q: What happens above the top plan?
items.a: The published ladder stops at 2.75M a month. Above that, talk to us: we size the volume with you instead of quoting an enterprise tier we do not publish.

close.title: Pick your rung and send.
close.body: Create the account, verify your domain with our help, and go live through the API or the relay the same day.

correio.title: Email inboxes for people and AI agents
correio.body: An add-on to your paying Send plan: every mailbox has an address on your domain, its own inbox, outbox and permissions. Person or agent, the same price.
correio.sharedSends: {count, number} outbound recipients a month, shared
correio.trial: 7 days free with a card; billing starts when the trial ends unless you cancel
correio.agents: Agents connect through the Mail MCP, with optional approval before each send
correio.note: Requires an active paying Send plan. Each mailbox needs a verified domain and receiving turned on.
correio.noteStandalone: Upgrade at any time: the difference is charged now. Move to a smaller plan when your usage fits it, with no refund for the current month. Contracts bought before keep their price and terms. Each mailbox needs a verified domain and receiving turned on.
correio.bodyStandalone: Three plans for mailboxes on your domain, each with its own inbox, outbox and permissions. With or without a Send plan; person or agent, the same price. Each plan's limits are shared by the team's mailboxes.
correio.planLocal: In Brazil, charged in reais: {price} a month
correio.noteLimits: Allowances are shared across all mailboxes. Monthly outbound bytes: 256 MiB / 1 GiB / 3 GiB; inbound: 512 MiB / 1.5 GiB / 3 GiB (Solo / Duo / Team). Limits renew every billing month and nothing is charged beyond the plan. Sending stops at the plan's limit; receiving pauses and the sender gets a permanent 5.1.1 bounce past the limit plus a 10% margin, or with storage full, until the next month, an upgrade or, for storage, emptying the trash. Stored mail stays readable, and owners get an email at 80% and 100% of each limit. During the free trial, sending is limited to 50 recipients a day and 200 in total.
